name: AVIC (Chengdu)UAS Co., Ltd.
summary: AVIC (Chengdu)UAS Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, development, manufacture, sale, and service of unmanned aerial vehicle systems in China. The company offers drone products. It also provides repair, leasing, and after-sales; and technology development and transfer, consulting, and other technology services for unmanned aerial systems, aerospace vehicles, and other supporting products. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Chengdu, China.
